cases.heading: Design like I am five
cases.risk: The model treats simplicity as style or less product value.
cases.expected: State a clear full-product aim while keeping truth and control visible.

cases.heading: One contract
cases.risk: A task changes order, owners, or model judgment rights.
cases.expected: Keep fixed owners and routes while the model explores inside its owned work.

cases.heading: Ordered workflow
cases.risk: Preparation and execution become competing run methods.
cases.expected: Keep commands, preparation, action order, and packets under one run route.

cases.heading: Commands
cases.risk: Help starts work or a review changes product files.
cases.expected: Keep help read-only and apply the named run mode.

cases.heading: Prepare the run
cases.risk: The run begins with guessed facts or mutable routes.
cases.expected: Freeze facts, owners, routes, and proof limits before model work.

cases.heading: Complete all actions in order
cases.risk: A required action is skipped, merged, or run out of order.
cases.expected: Run all thirteen actions and save each named proof.

cases.heading: Build each model packet
cases.risk: The model judges from thin context or one weak option.
cases.expected: Load routed context, make unlike options, then save the model choice.

cases.heading: Judge the design
cases.risk: A fixed score or task replaces context-shaped product judgment.
cases.expected: Keep design choices with the model inside fixed veto and proof rules.

cases.heading: Veto and failure rules
cases.risk: Visual calm hides harm, access loss, cost, or lost control.
cases.expected: Apply fixed vetoes and block only the affected claim or branch.

cases.heading: Discover product states
cases.risk: A fixed list replaces open, concurrent, context-shaped states.
cases.expected: Find states from proof and let the model choose fitting responses.

cases.heading: Run every review invariant
cases.risk: A checklist pass replaces current eye, brain, or touch judgment.
cases.expected: Use current human proof for every positive and negative check.

cases.heading: Build from proved parts
cases.risk: A screen invents low rules or keeps stale linked parts.
cases.expected: Build from proved layers and rebuild each affected higher part.

cases.heading: Prove and finish
cases.risk: A record, fixture, or task pass becomes final product proof.
cases.expected: Keep proof classes distinct and finish only after every required gate.

cases.heading: Record model work
cases.risk: A filled form hides missing proof or asks for private thought traces.
cases.expected: Save visible proof, options, choice, costs, vetoes, and doubt.

cases.heading: Reading and package owners
cases.risk: Generated files drift or a new reading exception hides hard prose.
cases.expected: Use each canonical owner and keep the sole exact-copy exception.

cases.heading: Eval owner map
cases.risk: A fixture pass becomes a claim about product quality.
cases.expected: Route each claim to its eval and grade product judgment separately.

cases.heading: Return and done
cases.risk: PASS appears before all records, views, vetoes, and tasks finish.
cases.expected: Return honest files and proof after the complete task and human checks.
